purpose: EVALUATION ONLY. Inference code must never read, import or reference this file. Frozen before any v1/v2 run on this document (pre-observation commit of the v2-B additional-holdout task).
method: Transcribed mechanically from the document's own table of contents (poppler pdftotext -layout, physical page 3 cropped into left/right columns at x=408pt, regex over printed lines: （組織）NNN name page / （項）NNN name page / request-no NN-NN name page). Names are the first printed line. The TOC also prints （会計）and（所管）lines above the organization; they are not hierarchy nodes of this evaluation (same as the MAFF 復興特会 fixture). Independent consistency checks (not derived from any v1/v2 output): request numbers consecutive 1..12, printed start pages non-decreasing, every item has at least one request. The extraction script is a scratch tool and is not committed.
codeNote: Request codes written with ASCII '-'. depth 1/2/3 = organization/item/request (labels of this evaluation file only). set='test'.
